conflicts: MICRO-PLUS local sheet width 15.6 mm; downloaded 3DS and product card width 16 mm. Using downloaded model version.
Delux 24D160-10-3097-810 local sheet width 10 mm; manufacturer product page width 8 mm. Using 8 mm.
Catalog generic warranty and features conflict with some individual product fields: not imported.
Delux CRI97, COB LB and Slim use local catalog cutting pitch 50 mm; confirm on PCB. CCT 100 mm and 3in1 50 mm are checked against manufacturer cards.
CCT 24E024-100-10-CCT: local aggregate data lists 2700 K and 50 mm. Manufacturer catalog says 3000–6500 K and 100 mm. Using manufacturer data.
3in1 24D160-11-3080-1010: local generic description incorrectly implies switching mains power to change modes. Manufacturer card specifies connection to L/M/H, 3/6/11 W/m.
3in1 PDF lumen row has inconsistent units for medium/high; official product title gives 460/930/1750 lm/m. Only used as a relative artistic light scale.

S-shape aggregate catalog says 8 mm and cut 25 mm. Manufacturer PDF page 16 says 6 mm and 50 mm; using manufacturer PDF. Three temperature variants use PDF lumen data 920 / 1000 / 1030 lm/m; these differ from rounded store descriptions.

Premium Slim5 aggregate data says 50 mm cut, CRI90 and 700 lm/m. Manufacturer PDF page 15 prints 31 mm, CRI80 and 720 lm/m for 24ES004-031-5-NW. Using that documented catalog version; printed pitch may be rounded and needs confirmation on physical PCB.
New profile colors limited to documented finish variants; MICRO-K uses archived silver merchant item only.
simplifications: PDS-4-PLUS envelope and channel from worksheet. Simplified cross section, not original CAD.
Except for the HS geometry included in MICRO-PLUS 3DS, cover shapes and LED PCB geometry are illustrative; uploaded artwork supplies only the surface image.
CCT and illumination are visual comparison, no photometry or lux claims.
CE/RoHS optional concept artwork does not assert product conformity. Source 3in1 card has marks, but proposed PCB location is unverified.
CCT uses 5050 dual emitter model, 3 terminals +24V/CW/WW. 3in1 uses 2835 with 4 pads and only the selected negative terminal connected. Wire colors are illustrative.
Supplemental room lighting is excluded from SKU BOM and electrical calculations. No measured lux or CRI simulation.
Room cameras use fixed targets, bounded azimuth/polar angle and zoom; no free panning. Day/night exterior is generated artwork from built-in imagegen; prompts saved in assets/environment/prompts.md.
Additional profile contours are authored from manufacturer cards and dimension drawings; retaining lips, wall details and all non-MICRO covers are illustrative, not original CAD.
Cabinets, drawers, hinges, cable channels, brackets, screws, springs and routing clearances are demonstration geometry. They are not selected accessory SKUs or fabrication dimensions.
S-shape contour is modeled after the official flat strip photo s-shape-reference.jpg; lateral bend illustrates flexibility without specifying a minimum bend radius.
Mounting sample is 100 mm; zone product is 300 mm; GLB is full ordered length with complete cut sections of LED tape.
Room visualization modules and UI removed in V5. Future real-photo lighting concept recorded in ROADMAP.md.
